name: dearmy-planner-app
description: Read and manage your DearMY planner from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: DearMY Planner connects ChatGPT to your DearMY planner. After you sign in with your DearMY account and approve access, ChatGPT can read your planner context, categories, tasks and special dates, show today's briefing, and, only after you confirm, create, update or complete tasks, save a diary draft, and propose or apply a re-plan for overdue tasks (with undo). Every change requires explicit confirmation, uses a request key to avoid duplicates, and checks the planner revision to avoid overwriting newer edits. The connector cannot read your saved diary entries, cannot delete anything, and you can revoke access at any time from DearMY settings.
defaultPrompt: What's on my DearMY plan today? Give me a short briefing.
Add 'Prepare slides' to my Work category for tomorrow 3pm.
I fell behind this week. Suggest a re-plan of my overdue tasks.
